title: Famous Places in the World
text:
The Eiffel Tower is in Paris. It is very tall and made of iron. Many people visit it every year. You can climb the stairs or take the elevator.

The Great Wall is in China. It is very long and very old. People walk on the top of the wall. Some people walk for a whole day.

questions.text: What country is the Great Wall in?
Why might a person need a lot of time to walk on the Great Wall?
options: Because it is under the sea

questions.text: What can you infer about the Eiffel Tower?
options: It is a famous place for visitors

vocabulary.definition: having a greater height than most things or people
a strong metal used to build things
a set of steps that go up or down
having a large distance from one end to the other

paragraph_translations: A Torre Eiffel fica em Paris. Ela é muito alta e feita de ferro. Muitas pessoas a visitam todos os anos. Você pode subir as escadas ou pegar o elevador.
A Muralha da China fica na China. Ela é muito comprida e muito antiga. As pessoas andam sobre o topo da muralha. Algumas pessoas caminham o dia inteiro.
